name: Goi kho bo
summary: Gỏi khô bò is on Con Market’s outdoor list on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup, with ram cuốn cải, hủ tiếu, bánh canh, and hột vịt lộn. The page does not describe the salad.
origin: Named at Con Market’s outdoor counters. A dressing was not printed.
howToEat: The 2019 page names gỏi khô bò and does not describe a method. Check on arrival.
